values.note: The dates Let's Camp offers for 2027 (April 1 - October 20). 'Early/Late Season Bookings: ... due to outdoor temperatures water service at site, public showers, public washrooms & laundry services may not be available'; 'It is estimated that the water will be turned on May 15th.'

Let's Camp shows a price 'starting at' C$45, tax included, and says 'This campground has dynamic pricing set and the price you pay for your site may vary'; early- and late-season rates are 'adjusted' when water is off. The town's own page posts no rate table. Read 2026-11-10 with booking closed until April 1, 2027.

note: Town of Viking campground in a residential area on a tree-lined street, beside Eastview Playground; free firewood. The sewer dump station is at the town's water tower (5015-51 Avenue), not at the campground. --Claude
